versions.subject: feat: update gpg4win rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'gpg.exe'
filter_main_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\gpg.exe'
        - '\gpg2.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
